capturedWith: Recovered from a failed live UAT run's own stderr log — not a deliberate capture. The run this fixture is frozen from timed out and failed (05-LIVE-RUN-01M3C48C-FAILED.log). These twelve lines were the harness's own unrecognised-sidecar-event stderr slices, emitted while the run was still in progress.

truncation.mechanism: scripts/uat/lib/sidecar-harness.mjs writes `[uat] unrecognised sidecar event: ${(raw ?? "").slice(0, 200)}` to stderr for every event the shipped normaliser classifies as unknown — 200 characters of raw JSON, then nothing.

note: These are PREFIXES, cut at 200 characters of raw JSON by the harness's own unmodelled-event logger (scripts/uat/lib/sidecar-harness.mjs). Each reconstructed `line` below carries ONLY the complete key/value pairs visible before the cut. Nothing after the cut is reconstructed, guessed, or inferred from how the shape probably continues. The cost of this — that the product cannot know what else these lines carry — is exactly why plan 05-37's Task 3 replaces the truncating logger with a durable, full-fidelity capture beside it.

shapes.lostToTruncation: A further field inside rate_limit_info whose key begins with the visible partial key "unifiedW" — its full name and value are unknown and are not reconstructed.

shapes.lostToTruncation: The thinking block's own signature value — present on the wire (the observed prefix ends mid-value inside the signature field) but not reconstructed here. This shape's line intentionally carries NO signature key at all: a signature was present on the wire, but its value is unknown, and inventing one would assert something nobody measured.
